listing.name: Mario Kart: Double Dash!! — MarioKartDD Recomp (ethannicholas) (ethannicholas)
listing.summary: The project reports reaching menus and a Grand Prix race with sound. Completion of the full game has not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA GM4E01 ISO or CISO. The required main.dol SHA-1 is e389e50357d4a5076ab3d38672204658f411123d.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate the game code and build it locally using the project’s source instructions. Keep your original disc image available when playing.

warnings: The project reports reaching the boot screen, menus and a Grand Prix race with sound. Completion of the full game has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
